dave (Eng Manager): Quick question from a manager: we promoted someone during a hiring freeze and want to increase comp beyond band max. Is that allowed?
cecilia (People Ops): Hiring freeze doesn't automatically block promotions, but increases above band max are exceptional. You need manager + director sign-off and a compensation justification packet.
sasha (Compensation): Correct. Submit /forms/comp-change-request and pick 'Exception: Above band'. Provide 3 evidence bullets tied to the leveling rubric and any peer comps. Committee will evaluate tradeoffs (parity, compression).
harper (HRBP): Also include employee impact notes (retention risk, flight risk) and confirmation that this isn't part of wide-scale band rework.
dave (Eng Manager): If committee approves, can we do retro pay? employee started receiving lower comp for 2 pay cycles already.
mike (Payroll): We can do retro pay as a one-off if approval is before payroll cutoff (10th). If after cutoff it'll post on next payroll. Retro amounts are taxed per payroll rules.
sasha (Compensation): One nuance: if this pushes someone past the band max by a lot, Compensation might propose an alternate like a phased raise or spot retention bonus to avoid long-term compression. We'll document options in the decision.
cecilia (People Ops): Managers, checklist to speed this: 1) /forms/comp-change-request -> 'Exception' 2) attach rubric examples, peer comps, and director sign-off 3) state requested effective date 4) cc Finance if >$25k ARR impact.
dave (Eng Manager): What about equity? can we top-up equity instead of base to avoid pushing them above band?
sasha (Compensation): Equity top-ups are possible but require Total Rewards approval and may wait for the next grant cycle. If timing is urgent, committee sometimes approves a one-time cash + future equity plan.
cecilia (People Ops): Final note: exceptions create precedent. If you're uncertain, ping me or @sasha with a short summary before submitting the form and we'll do a quick pre-check.
dave (Eng Manager): Thanks, will DM the summary now.
cecilia (People Ops): thx! I'll log a playbook example after this case is closed.
